note: Curated by Claude on 15 Nov 2026 from public sources; the daily job adds auto-detected items.

items.title: NCPA urges EPFO to stop rejecting higher pension claims, withdraw court appeals
items.summary: Reported by The Tribune. Open the notice for details and confirm in the official Gazette.

items.title: New EPF rules: Government can temporarily cut PF contributions during pandemics and national disasters - People Matters
items.summary: Reported by People Matters - HR News. Open the notice for details and confirm in the official Gazette.

items.title: EPFO launches six-month amnesty scheme for exempted provident fund trusts
items.summary: Reported by DD News. Open the notice for details and confirm in the official Gazette.

items.title: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026, Ministry of Civil Aviation : Notification No G.S.R. 957(E).
items.summary: Reported by Staff News. Open the notice for details and confirm in the official Gazette.

items.title: Shram Suvidha Form I update deadline under OSH (Central) Rules, 2026
items.summary: Ministry of Labour gazette notification dated 7 Nov 2026, effective 8 Nov: establishments must update Form I on the Shram Suvidha portal.

items.title: ESIC circular: higher funeral and confinement benefits
items.summary: Funeral expenses raised to ₹20,000, confinement to ₹15,000, medical-benefit contribution ₹50 a month, for cases on or after 8 May 2026.

items.title: CGIT special campaign for EPF appeals, 16–27 November 2026
items.summary: Central Government Industrial Tribunal, Chennai has preponed listed EPF appeals for a special campaign; other CGIT benches have issued campaign notices too.

items.title: EPFO: WhatsApp services and automatic settlement of inoperative accounts
items.summary: From 1 Nov 2026 members can get balance and passbook on WhatsApp; inoperative EPF accounts are settled automatically (PIB release 2331157).

items.title: Mizoram notifies OSH and Social Security Code Rules, 2026
items.summary: Gazette notifications of 13 Oct 2026 give Mizoram its own rules under two of the four Labour Codes.

items.title: EPFO: ECR due date for September 2026 extended to 31 October
items.summary: One-time extension from 15 October. For October 2026 wages the due date is Sunday 15 November 2026; no extension announced.

items.title: Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Meghalaya: October 2026 minimum wage notifications
items.summary: State notices of 8 Oct 2026 revise minimum wages/VDA for the April–October cycle.

items.title: Gujarat: special allowance under the CLRA Act from 1 October 2026
items.summary: Special allowance of up to ₹72.50 a day (₹1,885 a month) for contract labour from 1 Oct 2026; shops rules also amended on 3 Oct.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh: VDA up ₹150 to ₹3,000 a month from 1 October 2026
items.summary: Part of the October 2026 revision wave; Andhra Pradesh notified its VDA on 28 Sept (valid 1 Oct 2026 – 31 Mar 2027).

items.title: Central sphere VDA revised from 1 October 2026 (File No. 6/1/2026-VDA)
items.summary: Unskilled construction/cleaning/loading wage is ₹840 a day in Area A (₹704 B, ₹565 C) after CPI-IW rose from 424.80 to 431.42. Valid till 31 Mar 2027.

items.title: Notification S.O. 5109(E): EPF wage ceiling raised from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000
items.summary: Statutory wage ceiling for provident-fund coverage under Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, 2020 is now ₹25,000 a month.

items.title: EPFO VISHWAS 2026: settle old Section 14B damages at concessional rates
items.summary: For defaults before 14 June 2024; flat 0.25%–1% a month if full Section 7Q interest is paid. The window is understood to close on 28 December 2026.

items.title: Bonus under the Code on Wages: ₹21,000 limit (Gazette Nos. 4525 and 4526)
items.summary: Statutory bonus applies to employees earning up to ₹21,000 a month, calculated on ₹7,000 or the Central minimum wage, whichever is higher.

items.title: Maharashtra: special allowance order for 1 July 2026 (Order No. 7997, 5 Aug 2026)
items.summary: Notified late and retrospectively; employers owe arrears from 1 July 2026. Further orders followed on 7 and 11 Aug.

items.title: West Bengal pre-publishes draft rules under the Labour Codes (Kolkata Gazette, 13 July 2026)
items.summary: Draft West Bengal Code on Wages Rules, 2026 (No. Labr/103/Law) invites objections; some trackers still show no final state rules — check the Kolkata Gazette.

items.title: New EPF, pension and DLI schemes notified under the Code on Social Security
items.summary: Ministry of Labour notified three new schemes (provident fund, pension, deposit-linked insurance) plus three special schemes to clear legacy problems.

items.title: West Bengal: revised minimum wages 1 July – 31 December 2026
items.summary: Labour Commissionerate circular of 22 June 2026; Zone A unskilled about ₹10,558 a month (₹406 a day). Next revision due 1 January 2027.

items.title: Telangana: new minimum wage rates under the Code on Wages (30 May 2026)
items.summary: New basic rates from 1 June 2026; the VDA round for 1 October is due but was not notified at last check.

items.title: Karnataka: minimum wages and VDA notification KA 411 LWA 2023 (22 May 2026)
items.summary: Revised scheduled-employment rates for 2026-27 (Karnataka revises each 1 April).

items.title: Central Rules under all four Labour Codes notified (8–9 May 2026)
items.summary: Wages Rules (G.S.R. 343(E)), IR Rules (G.S.R. 342(E)), Social Security Rules (G.S.R. 344(E)) and OSH Rules, plus Model Standing Orders, 2026.

items.title: All four Labour Codes brought into force (21 November 2025)
items.summary: Gazette notifications put the Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and OSH Codes into force, replacing 29 central labour laws.
